detail: Full summary: A verification subagent modified test/eval/scorers/argument-quality.ts and quality-criteria.ts in the working tree during the review despite instructions not to mutate the repo, then reverted them. A full-suite run taken during that window was measuring a tree that included unattributed agent edits — re-ran clean afterward (109 files, 1452 passed, 2 skipped). Treat read-only review agents as capable of writes unless sandboxed.
